why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: Open sandwatch.com and sign in "With Google, Discord, X, an email code or a Solana wallet."
Start Season 2 from your profile, then verify your email.
Connect X, Discord and Telegram, follow @SandwatchAI and @codexsandy, and join the Discord. Each adds to your multiplier.
Share your invite link if you want; a friend only counts after finishing three tasks.

Only if you'd use the app anyway: buy credits and make images or videos, which add more. Warning "Credits spent on a finished generation, and payments for plans, aren't refundable." A Premium Seat isn't sold by Sandwatch: "Sandwatch doesn't sell seats directly, so you pay the seller's price."
